opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jesse Stewart (employee ID E013) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E013.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: admin
  - comment: Jesse Stewart (E013) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. As a full-time employee whose role owns the Payroll system, admin access is permitted. Recommend granting admin to Payroll.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E013 as a contractor with basic security training. Contractors never get admin; max allowed is read (no advanced training). Requested admin exceeds max, so recommend read for Payroll.
reason: Requested: admin to Payroll. HR notes state E013 is a full-time Payroll Specialist and admin is permitted since the role owns the system. However, Security notes state their DB shows E013 as a contractor with basic security training, and contractors never receive admin; without advanced training the max allowed is read. Given the conflicting employment-type records, the restrictive security data controls: admin is prohibited for contractors. Permitted max is read, which is below requested admin, so grant read.

HR note says: role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time. Recommendation: admin. Comment says full-time employee whose role owns the Payroll system, admin permitted.

1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If full_time Payroll Specialist: admin allowed (role owns system). Requested admin -> grant admin.
If contractor with basic training: max read -> grant read.

But wait, is there any chance the intended answer is admin? Let me consider the team structure: HR agent and Security agent each write notes. The Approver reads notes. The notes include recommendations. Perhaps we should consider the recommendations and underlying facts.
